name: dsh-remote-workspaces
description: DSH plugin: mirror workspaces of other DSH servers in this GUI — sessions render through a same-origin egress proxy (/remote/<server>/?embed=<session>) and are managed host-to-host over the remote's RPC. Needs the DSH branch feat/embed-session on the remote.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check egress.mjs && node --check state.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
